title: Palestinian Salad (Salata Falahiyeh)
summary: Tomatoes, small cucumbers and onion cut into small, even dice, then dressed with parsley, mint, lemon juice, olive oil and salt. Served immediately.

ingredients.item: ripe tomatoes, cut into 6 mm dice
small cucumbers, cut into 6 mm dice
small onion, cut into 6 mm dice
green chilli, seeded and finely minced (optional)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Chop
steps.text: Cut the tomatoes, cucumbers and onion into small, even 6 mm dice; the finer and more even the cut, the better the salad. Put them in the bowl with the chilli, if using.

steps.title: Dress and serve
steps.text: Add the parsley, mint, lemon juice, olive oil and salt and stir well. Taste for lemon and serve straight away, before the vegetables release their juices.

tips: Use the ripest tomatoes you can find; they carry the salad.
Spring onions are a milder swap for the onion.
Mop up the juices left in the bowl with bread.
storage: Best eaten within an hour. Chopped vegetables can be kept separately in the fridge for a few hours and dressed just before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
